coverage.summary: All residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley. The ordinance states no unit-count, building-age, construction-date or landlord-size limits.

evidence.quoted_span: levels that may be achieved for residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley.

result.notes: Summary narrowed to unit scope only. The original wording about landlords who use, and vendors who sell, coordinated pricing algorithms described regulated conduct, not covered buildings, units or owners, so it was removed. other_conditions set to null for two reasons: (1) the excluded-product list in § 13.63.020(A)(a)-(c) defines which algorithms are regulated, not which units or owners are covered, and it is already captured in the rule's exemptions field; (2) the reference to the state Cartwright Act (Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 16729) is not supported by any captured document. All other coverage fields stay null because D001 contains no unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy, landlord-size or preemption language. The Rent Ordinance coverage documents (D006, D009) concern a different chapter (13.76) and do not limit ch. 13.63.
